claims.gist: Hype Cycles graphically represent technology maturity and adoption
Hype Cycle methodology provides sound insight for deployment decisions
Clients use Hype Cycles to learn about emerging technologies
Early adopters who accept risk could reap rewards
Moderate executives insist on cost-benefit analysis
With unanswered viability questions, waiting may be better
At innovation trigger, usable products often do not exist
Peak brings success stories alongside many failures
In the trough, interest wanes and producers fail
On the slope, benefits crystallize and second-generation products appear
At the plateau, mainstream adoption takes off
Hype Cycles help separate hype from real commercial drivers
Hype Cycles reduce technology investment risk
Analysts provide objectivity on technology business value

thesis: Hype Cycles chart technology maturity through five phases, helping buyers separate hype from value and time investments.
